question: Should OpenClaw permanently store this metadata-only 512-row gateway restart audit ledger in shared SQLite, with the current redaction rules and direct state inspection as the initial access path?
rationale: The patch proves its mechanics and privacy invariants, but only maintainers can accept the durable retention, metadata, and operator-access contract for core state.

options.title: Approve bounded ledger
options.body: Accept the current metadata-only 512-row ledger and treat direct state inspection as the initial forensic access path.

options.title: Require read contract
options.body: Hold the PR until a bounded typed Gateway or CLI query surface and operator-facing documentation define supported access.

options.title: Decline durable storage
options.body: Keep restart attribution in transient logs or diagnostics rather than adding a permanent shared-state schema.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded ledger
recommendation.body: Accept the current metadata-only 512-row ledger and treat direct state inspection as the initial forensic access path.

likelyOwner.reason: The related maintainer-labeled audit proposal shows the clearest product ownership of metadata-only audit retention and access boundaries.
